top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Bean Bags, Waterbeds, Foam Pads As Sleeping Equipment (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, an infant was observed sleeping on a Boppy pillow.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The incident report was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not notifying parents of less serious injuries.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
